svg.title: A day at the office, the Git way
svg.desc: A comic strip of the seven daily steps as an office day. 1, 08:55, pull main: with a coffee in hand, you take today's edition of main from the GitHub cloud. 2, 09:00, create a branch: a smiling photocopier makes your own copy, named feature/q3-sales. 3, 09:05, make changes: you work at your desk while Claude floats nearby asking "Need a hand?". 4, 11:30, commit: a camera snaps the document with its red and green changes and a sticky note saying "Update Q3 figures", and you click Commit. 5, 17:00, push: you wave goodbye while your work flies up to GitHub; laptop lost, work isn't. 6, day 2, pull request: you hand the document with a "Please review" sticky note to a colleague at the review desk. 7, merge: an approved stamp, the work goes into the main binder and the old copy goes into a happy shredder, which is deleting the branch. 8, repeat: back on main with a fresh coffee, ready for the next task.
svg.text: A day at the office, the Git way
Seven steps, the same for every task. Coffee optional.
